Brief Job Descriptionor Justification Statementfor the request:
Program Coordinator for the Equatorial Phenomena of the Multiverse grant will be in charge of overseeing the graduate students,
scheduling and overseeing the lab and experiments, providing administrative and budgetary support to the PI, and generally
completing tasks per the award guidelines as needed.
The requesting department is responsible for securing the appropriate signatures prior to submission to the Human Resources
Office. In some cases, all signatures will not be required.
